rationale: The agent looked up the user and orders, then executed address and item modifications. However, it performed order-changing writes (modify_pending_order_address and modify_pending_order_items) without first confirming with the user, which violates the stated policy. It also did not clearly substantiate that the exchanged item was the cheapest green variant (product ID checks were inconsistent), and it provided no final confirmation of the changes. While some authentication was attempted via name and ZIP, the lack of pre-write confirmation alone fails the pass bar.
